as territorial princes. The judgments you render are final and may not be referred to a higher court. Fees, too, levies, taxes, rents and tolls, royalties on mines, salt works, and mints, tributes, safe conduct, fiefs— all are yours. This I do to prove to you my gratitude: you are raised today to a place quite close to Majesty.

@@U04342@@
Let me in the name of us all thank you, Majesty. In strengthening us you strengthen yourself as well.

@@U04344@@
I have a yet higher privilege for the five of you. Though I am still alive and long to live and rule my realm ambitiously, I nonetheless think back on my long ancestry and consider the doom that awaits us all. I, too, will one day part from my loved ones, and so, let it be your duty to name my successor and solemnize his coronation. May peace reign then, and our stormy times be ended.

@@U04346@@
Proud in heart, humble in posture, we princes, of all the earth the highest, bow before you. While blood flows through our veins, consider us one body intent on your every wish.

@@U04348@@
To make an end, then, let all that we have concluded be committed to writing and duly signed by us. As lords of the realm,
translation:
@@U04340@@
作为领土诸侯。您做出的判决是最终判决，不得提交至更高一级法院。还有费用、征税、税收、租金和通行费、矿山、盐厂和铸币厂的特许权使用费、贡品、安全通行权、封地——全都是你的。我这样做是为了向您表达我的感激之情：您今天被提升到一个非常接近陛下的位置。

@@U04342@@
让我以我们所有人的名义感谢您，陛下。在强化我们的同时，你也强化了自己。

@@U04344@@
我对你们五个人有更高的特权。尽管我还活着，渴望活着并雄心勃勃地统治我的王国，但我仍然回想起我悠久的祖先，并考虑等待着我们所有人的厄运。我也有一天会与我所爱的人分离，因此，任命我的继任者并为他举行加冕典礼是您的责任。愿和平降临，我们的暴风雨时代结束。

@@U04346@@
心高气傲，姿态谦卑，我们诸侯，天下至高者，跪拜在您面前。当血液在我们的血管中流动时，请将我们视为一个整体，专注于您的每一个愿望。

@@U04348@@
